用“生命周期评价”（LCA）比较植物肉与牛肉汉堡，结论通常如何？

What does LCA usually conclude comparing plant-based and beef burgers?

多数研究显示植物肉在温室气体、用地、用水上显著低于牛肉，尤其在反刍排放占比高时；但加工能耗与配料（如椰子油）使差距并非无限大，且营养等价需校准。
Most studies show plant-based burgers far lower in GHG, land and water than beef, especially given ruminant emissions; but processing energy and ingredients (e.g., coconut oil) shrink—not erase—the gap, and nutritional equivalence must be calibrated.

为什么“反刍动物甲烷”是食物系统减排的难点？

Why is ruminant methane a hard nut in food-system mitigation?

牛羊瘤胃发酵天然产生CH4，单位蛋白排放高；改善饲料、添加剂（如海藻）可降低但难清零，且涉及数十亿小农生计与饮食文化，政策需兼顾公平。
Cattle and sheep naturally emit CH4 via rumen fermentation, with high emissions per protein; feed and additives (e.g., seaweed) help but can't zero it, and it touches billions of smallholders and dietary culture, so policy must be fair.

氮肥的“生命周期”环境成本体现在哪些环节？

Where in its life cycle does nitrogen fertilizer impose environmental cost?

合成氨耗能排碳（哈伯法）、施肥后N2O（强温室气体）排放、淋溶造成水体富营养化与地下水硝酸盐超标，构成从能源到水体的多重代价。
Haber-Bosch ammonia synthesis is energy- and carbon-intensive; after application, N2O (potent GHG) emits and leaching causes eutrophication and nitrate contamination—multi-stage costs from energy to water.

什么是“食物损失”与“食物浪费”的区别？

What is the difference between food loss and food waste?

食物损失发生在供应链前端（收获、储存、运输中的损耗）；浪费发生在后端（零售、餐饮、家庭丢弃可食部分）。两者都意味着已投入的资源被白费。
Loss occurs upstream (harvest, storage, transport); waste occurs downstream (retail, food service, household discarding edible food). Both mean already-invested resources are wasted.

食物系统约占全球温室气体排放的多少？

What share of global GHG emissions comes from the food system?

约四分之一到三分之一，涵盖种植、施肥、养殖肠道发酵、加工、运输、冷藏与浪费。其中肉类与乳制品占比突出。
Roughly one-quarter to one-third, covering farming, fertilizer, livestock enteric fermentation, processing, transport, refrigeration and waste. Meat and dairy are prominent contributors.

什么是“食物里程”（food miles），它等于碳足迹吗？

What are 'food miles' and are they the same as carbon footprint?

食物里程是食物从产地到餐桌的运输距离；但碳足迹还包括生产、加工、冷藏等。有时本地未必更低碳（如本地温室番茄对比远方应季露天）。
Food miles are transport distance from farm to plate, but carbon footprint also includes production, processing and refrigeration. Local isn't always lower-carbon (e.g., local greenhouse tomatoes vs distant in-season field ones).

什么是“再生农业”（regenerative agriculture）？

What is regenerative agriculture?

通过覆盖作物、免耕、轮牧、堆肥等恢复土壤健康与生物多样性，目标是让土地“越种越肥”并固碳，区别于单纯减害的可持续农业。
Using cover crops, no-till, rotational grazing and compost to restore soil health and biodiversity, aiming to make land richer and sequester carbon—beyond merely reducing harm.

为什么“不浪费饭菜”也是在保护地球？

Why does not wasting food also protect Earth?

种菜养牛要用水、用地、排碳；剩饭倒掉，这些努力和白白的排放都浪费了。吃完不剩最省。
Growing food uses water, land and emits carbon; tossing leftovers wastes all that effort and emissions. Finishing your plate saves the most.
